description: This file defines the LoginLogDao class, which is a Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for persisting LoginLog entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes a method to save login log details to the database.

classes.name: LoginLogDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for handling database operations related to login logs in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveLoginLog
methods.description: Persists a LoginLog entity to the database and returns the persisted entity.
